name: Jawa Timur Open 2016

venue.name: STIEKEN (Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi Kesuma Negara)
venue.address: Jalan Mastrip No. 59, Kota Blitar, Jawa Timur
venue.details: The location is around 500 m from the blitar Train station

information: The biggest competition in East region of Java. Registration fees for early bird (before October 25) and on the spot are different. You can check the complete fees [here](http://jawatimuropen2016.weebly.com/pendaftaran.html). Please add your handphone number on the comment at registration. For more information you can contact the organizers.
